findings.title: Series game number
findings.summary: Game 2 showed the strongest historical ROI, but the effect was much stronger in 2025 than 2026. Game 3 was more stable across seasons but on a smaller sample.

findings.title: Movement size
findings.summary: The edge was not concentrated in the largest moves. 10-14c and 15-19c both remained profitable, supporting the current >=10c frozen threshold.

findings.title: Opening price
findings.summary: +160 to +179 was the only opening-price bucket negative in both 2025 and 2026. Sample size remains too small to exclude it.

findings.title: Money-ticket gap
findings.summary: RLM remained profitable even when money percentage did not exceed ticket percentage. Money-ticket gap is not required for v1 membership.

findings.title: Home vs away
findings.summary: Away dogs performed better overall, but much of the difference overlaps with opening-price mix. Venue should not be a filter.
